content.short: Solv Protocol is an on-chain fund platform offering Bitcoin yield strategies and diversified crypto investment products accessible on Mantle.
content.description: Solv Protocol is a decentralized fund infrastructure enabling fund managers to create and manage on-chain investment strategies accessible to global investors, with particular strength in Bitcoin yield products. Solv has grown to become the largest Bitcoin staking protocol by TVL, offering institutional-grade BTC yield strategies on-chain. Its integration with Mantle allows users to access diversified crypto yield strategies directly through the Mantle DeFi ecosystem.
